description: This PHP source file defines the PDFWrapper class within the SuiteCRM\PDF namespace. It manages PDF engine configurations, including adding, retrieving, and loading different PDF engine classes, and handles external dependencies and configuration settings related to PDF generation in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: PDFWrapper
classes.description: A class that manages PDF engine configurations, loading, and retrieval within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: addEngine
methods.description: Adds a new PDF engine configuration to the static engines array.

methods.name: getPDFEngine
methods.description: Retrieves the default or configured PDF engine instance, loading external configurations if available.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns a list of available PDF engine class names, considering external configuration and environment conditions.

methods.name: getDefaultEngine
methods.description: Returns the default PDF engine name based on configuration or fallback.

methods.name: fetchEngine
methods.description: Loads and instantiates a PDF engine class based on the provided engine name or class.

methods.name: getPDFConfig
methods.description: Retrieves PDF-related configuration values from the global $sugar_config array.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the configured PDF controller name, if any.
